description.en: Preserved Trapa fruit-only teaching organ with compact central body, four spreading horns and small backward-directed barbs, with rounded tips. No unknown leaves, stems, roots or whole plant; scale, color and exact pose artistic.
description.zh: 仅保存Trapa果实器官的教学展示：紧凑中央体、四条展开角臂及反向小倒刺，末端钝化。不添未知叶、茎、根或整株；尺度、颜色与姿态属美术选择。

artistic_choices.en: Nominal dimensions, original palette, exact repeated-feature counts and static pose are artistic. No strict species, specimen-copy, locomotion, animation or coexistence reconstruction.

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
